title: Education in focus: Significant improvements in student learning and satisfaction with ophthalmology teaching delivered using a blended learning approach
reason: Non-randomised comparison of two cohorts (online flipped classroom vs blended learning) on course-evaluation questionnaire responses and MCQ exam scores. No per-student platform activity indicator is analysed; only group contrasts.

extraction.country: Ireland (RCSI University of Medicine and Health Sciences; ethics approval and Royal Victoria Eye and Ear Hospital, Dublin)
extraction.n_quote: Descriptive statistics were used to describe the characteristics of the two groups (OFC (n = 28) vs BL (n = 59))
extraction.population: 4th-year medical students on an ophthalmology attachment, 2 cohorts
extraction.outcome_or_construct: course evaluation questionnaire (satisfaction, self-report); MCQ final exam score
extraction.notes: n is the sum of survey respondents 28 + 59; exam scores compared for full cohorts (114 and 257). No evidence of a difference in exam score.
